scope: Iraq medical discovery — University of Basrah College of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Basrah's College of Medicine says its undergraduate training covers basic, clinical and community medicine through lectures, tutorials, practical and clinical sessions, including inpatient, outpatient, emergency-room and surgical-theatre settings.
The College's published curriculum includes first- and second-year anatomy courses with theory and practical hours and clinical-anatomy learning objectives.

The Iraqi Ministry of Higher Education reported the inauguration of classrooms and laboratories at the College of Medicine and reviewed the specialised university-hospital project during a 2023 visit.
Iraq's National Council for Accreditation of Medical Colleges records conditional accreditation for University of Basrah College of Medicine, with its decision issued on 22 May 2022.
